plugins.name: guardrails-approval
plugins.description: A human signs off before anything that can't be undone: publishing, killing protected processes, editing secrets.

plugins.name: guardrails-records
plugins.description: Leave a trail a reviewer can follow: commit before 'done', date stale docs, snapshot databases, log every turn.

plugins.name: guardrails-monitoring
plugins.description: Keep watching after approval: hold agent reports for one review, check replies against a policy, date stale figures, watch the controls.

plugins.name: guardrails-development
plugins.description: Development standards: look before building, test what changed, pass the repo's checks, keep the rules in view.

plugins.name: guardrails-outcomes
plugins.description: Outcomes analysis: check what a reply claims against what the evidence supports.

plugins.name: guardrails-challenge
plugins.description: Effective challenge: hold answers to evidence under pushback, and check agents' commit claims against git.
